   387	theorem picRankOneTranslatedChart_pointwiseCoverage

   441	    picRankOneTranslatedChart_isOpenImmersion (C := C) hopen a
   442	  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology (Sigma.desc f) :=
   443	    isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_of_pointwise C f
   444	      (picRankOneTranslatedChart_pointwiseCoverage (C := C) hopen)

    14	
    15	The admissible Abel chart is etale-locally surjective onto the exact representing
    16	scheme obtained from the separably closed Picard construction.  Its quasi-compact
    17	divisor source therefore supplies quasi-compactness of that exact carrier, which
    18	packages into `PicRepDatum` and then `JacobianData` without changing the carrier or
    19	its representation.

    40	/-- Etale-local surjectivity of a Yoneda map is surjectivity on the underlying points. -/
    41	theorem surjective_of_isLocallySurjective_yoneda_map {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    42	    (h : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology (yoneda.map f)) :
    43	    Function.Surjective f.base := by
    44	  intro y
    45	  obtain ⟨cover, hcover⟩ := (Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff (P := @Etale)).mp
    46	    (h.imageSieve_mem (𝟙 Y))
    47	  obtain ⟨i, x, hx⟩ := cover.exists_eq y
    48	  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hcover (cover.X i) (cover.f i) (Presieve.ofArrows.mk i)
    49	  refine ⟨g.base x, ?_⟩
    50	  rw [← hx]
    51	  change g ≫ f = cover.f i at hg
    52	  exact congrArg (fun q : cover.X i ⟶ Y => q.base x) hg

    55	Picard representing scheme. -/

    57	    divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C ⟶ (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1 :=

    59	    (representableBySigmaIso (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2).inv)

    62	identifying the exact representing carrier with its sigma extension. -/
    63	theorem yoneda_map_abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
    64	    yoneda.map (abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter C) =
    65	      abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C ≫
    66	        (representableBySigmaIso (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2).inv :=
    67	  yoneda.preimage_spec _

    70	surjective. -/
    71	theorem isLocallySurjective_abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
    72	    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology
    73	      (yoneda.map (abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter C)) := by

    76	    (isLocallySurjective_abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C) _

     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# The quotient-side bridge for finite Galois descent of Picard zero
    11	
    12	A specified finite Galois quotient represents equivariant maps after base
    13	change.  This file records that statement in the over-category.  It is the
    14	scheme-theoretic half of descending a representative of `pic0TypeFunctor`.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	set_option autoImplicit false
    18	
    19	universe u
    20	
    21	open CategoryTheory Limits
    22	open AlgebraicGeometry
    23	
    24	namespace AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
    25	
    26	/-- An equivariant map from the finite-Galois base change of an object over
    27	`Spec K` to a semilinearly acted `L`-scheme. -/
    28	structure GaloisEquivariantOver
    29	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    30	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    31	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
    32	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) where
    33	  hom : pullback T.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ⟶ X
    34	  commutes : hom ≫ f =
    35	    pullback.snd T.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
    36	  equivariant : (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L T.hom).IsEquivariant rho hom
    37	
    38	namespace GaloisEquivariantOver
    39	
    40	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    41	  {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    42	  (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
    43	
    44	/-- Pull an equivariant map back along a morphism over `Spec K`. -/
    45	noncomputable def precomp
    46	    {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))} (a : T' ⟶ T)
    47	    (h : GaloisEquivariantOver rho T) : GaloisEquivariantOver rho T' where
    48	  hom := pullbackBaseChange K L T.hom T'.hom a.left a.w ≫ h.hom
    49	  commutes := by
    50	    rw [Category.assoc, h.commutes, pullbackBaseChange_snd]
    51	  equivariant := SemilinearGalAction.isEquivariant_pullbackBaseChange_comp
    52	    T.hom T'.hom rho h.equivariant a.left a.w
    53	
    54	@[ext]
    55	theorem ext {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))}
    56	    {h h' : GaloisEquivariantOver rho T} (hh : h.hom = h'.hom) : h = h' := by
    57	  cases h
    58	  cases h'
    59	  cases hh
    60	  rfl
    61	
    62	end GaloisEquivariantOver
    63	
    64	namespace GaloisQuotientWitness
    65	
    66	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    67	  {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    68	  {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
    69	  {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
    70	
    71	/-- A finite-Galois quotient witness represents equivariant maps after base
    72	change, with no affineness assumption on the test object. -/
    73	noncomputable def overHomEquiv (w : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y g)
    74	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) :
    75	    (T ⟶ Over.mk g) ≃ GaloisEquivariantOver rho T where
    76	  toFun a :=
    77	    { hom := pullbackBaseChange K L g T.hom a.left a.w ≫ w.e.hom
    78	      commutes := by
    79	        rw [Category.assoc, w.over, pullbackBaseChange_snd]
    80	      equivariant := SemilinearGalAction.isEquivariant_pullbackBaseChange_comp
    81	        g T.hom rho w.equivariant a.left a.w }
    82	  invFun h :=
    83	    Over.homMk
    84	      (w.universal T.left T.hom h.hom h.commutes h.equivariant).choose.1
    85	      (w.universal T.left T.hom h.hom h.commutes h.equivariant).choose.2
    86	  left_inv a := by
    87	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    88	    let h := pullbackBaseChange K L g T.hom a.left a.w ≫ w.e.hom
    89	    let hw := w.universal T.left T.hom h
    90	      (by
    91	        dsimp [h]
    92	        rw [Category.assoc, w.over, pullbackBaseChange_snd])
    93	      (by
    94	        dsimp [h]
    95	        exact SemilinearGalAction.isEquivariant_pullbackBaseChange_comp
    96	          g T.hom rho w.equivariant a.left a.w)
    97	    have ha : pullbackBaseChange K L g T.hom a.left a.w ≫ w.e.hom = h := rfl
    98	    have heq : hw.choose = ⟨a.left, a.w⟩ :=
    99	      hw.unique hw.choose_spec.1 ha
   100	    exact congrArg Subtype.val heq
   101	  right_inv h := by
   102	    apply GaloisEquivariantOver.ext rho
   103	    exact (w.universal T.left T.hom h.hom h.commutes h.equivariant).choose_spec.1
   104	
   105	/-- The quotient universal-property equivalence commutes with precomposition
   106	in the category of schemes over `Spec K`. -/
   107	theorem overHomEquiv_precomp (w : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y g)
   108	    {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))} (a : T' ⟶ T)
   109	    (b : T ⟶ Over.mk g) :
   110	    w.overHomEquiv T' (a ≫ b) =
   111	      GaloisEquivariantOver.precomp rho a (w.overHomEquiv T b) := by
   112	  apply GaloisEquivariantOver.ext rho
   113	  change pullbackBaseChange K L g T'.hom (a.left ≫ b.left) _ ≫ w.e.hom =
   114	    pullbackBaseChange K L T.hom T'.hom a.left a.w ≫
   115	      (pullbackBaseChange K L g T.hom b.left b.w ≫ w.e.hom)
   116	  rw [pullbackBaseChange_comp K L g T.hom T'.hom b.left b.w a.left a.w,
   117	    Category.assoc]
   118	
   119	end GaloisQuotientWitness
   120	
   121	namespace StableAffineOpen
   122	
   123	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
   124	  {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
   125	  (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
   126	
   127	/-- Under the orbit-in-an-affine-open hypothesis, the glued invariant-ring
   128	quotient represents equivariant maps after finite Galois base change. -/
   129	noncomputable def gluedQuotientOverHomEquiv
   130	    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] [rho.OrbitsInAffineOpen]
   131	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) :
   132	    (T ⟶ gluedQuotientOver rho) ≃ GaloisEquivariantOver rho T :=
   133	  (gluedGaloisQuotientWitness rho).toGaloisQuotientWitness.overHomEquiv T
   134	
   135	/-- The glued-quotient equivalence is natural under precomposition. -/
   136	theorem gluedQuotientOverHomEquiv_precomp
   137	    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] [rho.OrbitsInAffineOpen]
   138	    {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))} (a : T' ⟶ T)
   139	    (b : T ⟶ gluedQuotientOver rho) :
   140	    gluedQuotientOverHomEquiv rho T' (a ≫ b) =
   141	      GaloisEquivariantOver.precomp rho a (gluedQuotientOverHomEquiv rho T b) :=
   142	  GaloisQuotientWitness.overHomEquiv_precomp
   143	    (gluedGaloisQuotientWitness rho).toGaloisQuotientWitness a b
   144	
   145	end StableAffineOpen
   146	
   147	end AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0SepClosedRepresentable
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AdmissibleAbelEtaleSurjective
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AdmissibleDivisorQuasiProjective
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.CompactImageQc
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.JacobianDataFromPicRepDatum

/-!
# The separably closed Picard representer as Jacobian data

The admissible Abel chart is etale-locally surjective onto the exact representing
scheme obtained from the separably closed Picard construction.  Its quasi-compact
divisor source therefore supplies quasi-compactness of that exact carrier, which
packages into `PicRepDatum` and then `JacobianData` without changing the carrier or
its representation.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

noncomputable section

/-- Etale-local surjectivity of a Yoneda map is surjectivity on the underlying points. -/
theorem surjective_of_isLocallySurjective_yoneda_map {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (h : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology (yoneda.map f)) :
    Function.Surjective f.base := by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨cover, hcover⟩ := (Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff (P := @Etale)).mp
    (h.imageSieve_mem (𝟙 Y))
  obtain ⟨i, x, hx⟩ := cover.exists_eq y
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hcover (cover.X i) (cover.f i) (Presieve.ofArrows.mk i)
  refine ⟨g.base x, ?_⟩
  rw [← hx]
  change g ≫ f = cover.f i at hg
  exact congrArg (fun q : cover.X i ⟶ Y => q.base x) hg

/-- The admissible Abel chart, viewed as a scheme morphism to the exact separably closed
Picard representing scheme. -/
noncomputable def abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter (C) :
    divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C ⟶ (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1 :=
  yoneda.preimage (abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C ≫
    (representableBySigmaIso (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2).inv)

/-- The Yoneda map of the represented Abel morphism is the admissible Abel chart after
identifying the exact representing carrier with its sigma extension. -/
theorem yoneda_map_abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter (C) :
    yoneda.map (abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter C) =
      abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C ≫
        (representableBySigmaIso (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2).inv :=
  by rw [yoneda.map_preimage]

/-- The Abel morphism to the exact separably closed Picard representer is etale-locally
surjective. -/
theorem isLocallySurjective_abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter (C) :
    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology
      (yoneda.map (abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter C)) := by
  rw [yoneda_map_abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter]
  exact Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective.comp_right_isIso
    (isLocallySurjective_abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C) _

/-- The admissible Abel morphism is surjective on the underlying points of the exact
separably closed Picard representative. -/
theorem surjective_abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter (C) :

   676	/--
   677	Given a cofiltered diagram `D` of quasi-compact `S`-schemes with affine transition maps,
   678	and another scheme `X` of finite type over `S`.
   679	Then the canonical map `colim Homₛ(Dᵢ, X) ⟶ Homₛ(lim Dᵢ, X)` is injective.
   680	
   681	In other words, for each pair of `a : Homₛ(Dᵢ, X)` and `b : Homₛ(Dⱼ, X)` that give rise to the
   682	same map `Homₛ(lim Dᵢ, X)`, there exists a `k` with `fᵢ : k ⟶ i` and `fⱼ : k ⟶ j` such that
   683	`D(fᵢ) ≫ a = D(fⱼ) ≫ b`.

   688	    {j : I} (b : D.obj j ⟶ X) (hb : t.app j = b ≫ f)
   689	    (hab : c.π.app i ≫ a = c.π.app j ≫ b) :
   690	    ∃ (k : I) (hik : k ⟶ i) (hjk : k ⟶ j),
   691	      D.map hik ≫ a = D.map hjk ≫ b := by
   692	  let o := IsCofiltered.min i j

   695	    (by simp [← ha])
   696	    (by simp [← hb]) (by simpa)
   697	  use k, hik ≫ IsCofiltered.minToLeft i j, hik ≫ IsCofiltered.minToRight i j

/-- Galois invariance is the full compatibility condition for the
field-extension cover, not only the equality on its chosen pullback. -/
theorem pic0GaloisInvariant_compatible
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
    (x : Pic0GaloisInvariant (L := L) C T)
    {Z : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))}
    (g₁ g₂ : Z ⟶ (restrictTest K L).obj (baseTest (k' := L) T))
    (h : g₁ ≫ coverMap (k' := L) T = g₂ ≫ coverMap (k' := L) T) :
    (pic0TypeFunctor C).map g₁.op x.1 =
      (pic0TypeFunctor C).map g₂.op x.1 := by
  let q : Z ⟶ pullback (coverMap (k' := L) T) (coverMap (k' := L) T) :=
    pullback.lift g₁ g₂ h
  calc
    (pic0TypeFunctor C).map g₁.op x.1 =
        (pic0TypeFunctor C).map q.op
          ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map
            (pullback.fst (coverMap (k' := L) T) (coverMap (k' := L) T)).op x.1) := by
      rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp,
        pullback.lift_fst]
    _ = (pic0TypeFunctor C).map q.op
          ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map
            (pullback.snd (coverMap (k' := L) T) (coverMap (k' := L) T)).op x.1) :=
      congrArg ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map q.op)
        (pic0GaloisInvariant_pullback_condition C T x)
    _ = (pic0TypeFunctor C).map g₂.op x.1 := by
      rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp,
        pullback.lift_snd]

omit [GeometricallyReduced C.hom] in
/-- The Sigma-extension element attached to an invariant class is compatible
for the singleton field-extension cover. -/
theorem pic0GaloisInvariant_sigma_compatible
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
    (x : Pic0GaloisInvariant (L := L) C T)
    {Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (p₁ p₂ : Z ⟶ ((restrictTest K L).obj (baseTest (k' := L) T)).left)
    (hp : p₁ ≫ (coverMap (k' := L) T).left =
      p₂ ≫ (coverMap (k' := L) T).left) :
    (pic0SigmaFunctor C).map p₁.op
        ⟨((restrictTest K L).obj (baseTest (k' := L) T)).hom, x.1⟩ =
      (pic0SigmaFunctor C).map p₂.op
        ⟨((restrictTest K L).obj (baseTest (k' := L) T)).hom, x.1⟩ := by
  let B := (restrictTest K L).obj (baseTest (k' := L) T)
  have hbase : p₁ ≫ B.hom = p₂ ≫ B.hom := by
    rw [← Over.w (coverMap (k' := L) T)]
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg (fun q => q ≫ T.hom) hp
  let ZK : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := Over.mk (p₁ ≫ B.hom)
  let g₁ : ZK ⟶ B := Over.homMk p₁ rfl
  let g₂ : ZK ⟶ B := Over.homMk p₂ hbase.symm
  have hg : g₁ ≫ coverMap (k' := L) T = g₂ ≫ coverMap (k' := L) T := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    exact hp
  have hfib : (pic0TypeFunctor C).map g₁.op x.1 =
      (pic0TypeFunctor C).map g₂.op x.1 :=
    pic0GaloisInvariant_compatible C T x g₁ g₂ hg
  let y := (pic0TypeFunctor C).map g₁.op x.1
  have h₁ : (pic0SigmaFunctor C).map p₁.op ⟨B.hom, x.1⟩ =
      ⟨p₁ ≫ B.hom, y⟩ :=
    (Over.sigmaExtension_map_mk_eq_iff (F := pic0TypeFunctor C)
      p₁ rfl x.1 y).mpr rfl
  have h₂ : (pic0SigmaFunctor C).map p₂.op ⟨B.hom, x.1⟩ =
      ⟨p₁ ≫ B.hom, y⟩ :=
    (Over.sigmaExtension_map_mk_eq_iff (F := pic0TypeFunctor C)
      p₂ hbase.symm x.1 y).mpr hfib.symm
  exact h₁.trans h₂.symm

/-- Every invariant class descends uniquely along the finite-Galois field
extension cover.  This is the effective-descent half of the comparison. -/
theorem pic0GaloisInvariant_existsUnique_descend
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
    (x : Pic0GaloisInvariant (L := L) C T) :
    ∃! y : (pic0TypeFunctor C).obj (op T),
      (pic0TypeFunctor C).map (coverMap (k' := L) T).op y = x.1 := by
  rcases T with ⟨T, t⟩
  let B := (restrictTest K L).obj (baseTest (k' := L) (Over.mk t))
  let f := (coverMap (k' := L) (Over.mk t)).left
  haveI : Etale f := by
    exact Scheme.etale_pullback_fst_specMap K L T t
  haveI : Surjective f := by
    exact Scheme.surjective_pullback_fst_specMap K L T t
  haveI : Flat f := inferInstance
  haveI : EffectiveEpi f := inferInstance
  have hmem : Presieve.singleton f ∈ Scheme.precoverage (@Etale) T := by
    rw [Scheme.singleton_mem_precoverage_iff]
    exact ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
  have hsheaf : Presieve.IsSheafFor (pic0SigmaFunctor C)
      (Presieve.singleton f) :=
    (pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheaf_etale C).isSheafFor_of_mem_precoverage hmem
  rw [Presieve.isSheafFor_singleton] at hsheaf
  obtain ⟨⟨a, z⟩, hz, hzu⟩ := hsheaf ⟨B.hom, x.1⟩
    (fun p₁ p₂ hp => pic0GaloisInvariant_sigma_compatible C (Over.mk t) x p₁ p₂ hp)
  have hfirst : f ≫ a = B.hom := congrArg Sigma.fst hz
  have hcover : f ≫ t = B.hom := Over.w (coverMap (k' := L) (Over.mk t))
  have ha : a = t := (cancel_epi f).mp (hfirst.trans hcover.symm)
  subst a
  have hz' : (pic0TypeFunctor C).map (coverMap (k' := L) (Over.mk t)).op z = x.1 :=
    (Over.sigmaExtension_map_mk_eq_iff (F := pic0TypeFunctor C)
      f hcover z x.1).mp hz
  refine ⟨z, hz', ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hySigma : (pic0SigmaFunctor C).map f.op ⟨t, y⟩ = ⟨B.hom, x.1⟩ :=
    (Over.sigmaExtension_map_mk_eq_iff (F := pic0TypeFunctor C)
      f hcover y x.1).mpr hy
  have hpair := hzu ⟨t, y⟩ hySigma
  cases hpair
  rfl

    59	/-- Restriction of sections is strictly functorial. -/
    60	lemma resAlgHom_comp (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) {U V W : T.left.Opens} (h : U ≤ V)
    61	    (h' : V ≤ W) :
    62	    (resAlgHom T h).comp (resAlgHom T h') = resAlgHom T (h.trans h') := by
    63	  have key : T.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE h').op ≫ T.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
    64	      = T.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h.trans h')).op := by
    65	    rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]
    66	  ext s
    67	  exact congr($(key).hom s)

    69	/-- Restriction along the trivial inclusion is the identity. -/
    70	lemma resAlgHom_rfl (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) {U : T.left.Opens} (h : U ≤ U) :
    71	    resAlgHom T h = AlgHom.id k Γ(T.left, U) := by
    72	  have key : T.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op = 𝟙 Γ(T.left, U) := by
    73	    rw [show (homOfLE h).op = 𝟙 (Opposite.op U) from rfl, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    74	  ext s
    75	  exact congr($(key).hom s)

    80	    (V : T.left.Opens) (U : T'.left.Opens) (e : U ≤ f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    81	    CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k Γ(T.left, V)) ≫ f.left.appLE V U e

    84	    Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE,
    85	    Scheme.Hom.appLE_congr_hom (Over.w f) ⊤ U _
    86	      (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top T'.hom).ge)]

   110	    exact Scheme.Hom.appLE_congr_hom (Over.comp_left _ _ _ g f).symm V W _ e₃

    12

    14	honest sheaf for the big Zariski topology on `Scheme`, and mathlib's 01JJ
    15	local-representability engine applied to it descends to a representation of the

    20	  (`pic0TypeFunctor_obj`/`pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply` are `rfl`).

    24	  certificate.  By mathlib's own reduction the big-site sheaf condition collapses to
    25	  elementwise ∃!-amalgamation on honest open covers

    93	  intro Y S hS
    94	  obtain ⟨𝓤, rfl⟩ := Scheme.exists_cover_of_mem_pretopology hS
    95	  rw [Presieve.isSheafFor_arrows_iff]
    96	  intro x hx
    97	  -- glue the Σ-components along the scheme-level cover
    98	  have hpair : ∀ i j, pullback.fst (𝓤.f i) (𝓤.f j) ≫ (x i).1

   100	    congrArg Sigma.fst
   101	      (hx i j (pullback (𝓤.f i) (𝓤.f j)) (pullback.fst _ _) (pullback.snd _ _)
   102	        pullback.condition)
   103	  obtain ⟨aY, ha⟩ : ∃ aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k), ∀ i, 𝓤.f i ≫ aY = (x i).1 :=
   104	    ⟨𝓤.glueMorphisms (fun i => (x i).1) hpair,
   105	      fun i => 𝓤.ι_glueMorphisms (fun i => (x i).1) hpair i⟩
   106	  -- the induced slice cover of `Over.mk aY` and its member sections

   108	      ((Over.homMk (𝓤.f i) (ha i) : Over.mk ((x i).1) ⟶ Over.mk aY)).left :=
   109	    fun i => 𝓤.map_prop i
   110	  have hcov : ∀ p : (Over.mk aY).left, ∃ i, p ∈ Scheme.Hom.opensRange
   111	      ((Over.homMk (𝓤.f i) (ha i) : Over.mk ((x i).1) ⟶ Over.mk aY)).left := by
   112	    intro p
   113	    obtain ⟨i, y, hy⟩ := 𝓤.exists_eq p
   114	    exact ⟨i, y, hy⟩
   115	  -- the fibre components are a compatible family on the slice cover
   116	  have hcompat : ∀ (i j : 𝓤.I₀) (Z : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   117	      (gi : Z ⟶ Over.mk ((x i).1)) (gj : Z ⟶ Over.mk ((x j).1)),
   118	      gi ≫ (Over.homMk (𝓤.f i) (ha i) : Over.mk ((x i).1) ⟶ Over.mk aY)
   119	          = gj ≫ (Over.homMk (𝓤.f j) (ha j) : Over.mk ((x j).1) ⟶ Over.mk aY) →
   120	      pic0Map C gi ((x i).2) = pic0Map C gj ((x j).2) := by
   121	    intro i j Z gi gj hg
   122	    have hleft : gi.left ≫ 𝓤.f i = gj.left ≫ 𝓤.f j := congrArg Over.Hom.left hg
   123	    have hdesc := Over.map_eq_of_sigmaExtension_map_eq gi gj
   124	      (hx i j Z.left gi.left gj.left hleft)
   125	    rwa [pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply, pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply] at hdesc
   126	  -- glue the fibre components by the stage-1 evaluation bridge
   127	  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsu⟩ := pic0Subgroup_existsUnique_of_cover
   128	    (fun i => (Over.homMk (𝓤.f i) (ha i) : Over.mk ((x i).1) ⟶ Over.mk aY))
   129	    hcov (fun i => (x i).2) hcompat
   130	  refine ⟨⟨aY, s⟩, fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
   131	  · -- the glued Σ-element restricts to the members
   132	    refine (Over.sigmaExtension_map_mk_eq_iff (𝓤.f i) (ha i) s ((x i).2)).mpr ?_
   133	    rw [pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply]
   134	    exact hs i
   135	  · -- uniqueness: Σ-components by `hom_ext`, fibres by bridge separation
   136	    rintro ⟨a', s'⟩ ht'
   137	    obtain rfl : aY = a' := 𝓤.hom_ext aY a' fun i =>
   138	      (ha i).trans (congrArg Sigma.fst (ht' i) : 𝓤.f i ≫ a' = (x i).1).symm
   139	    refine congrArg (Sigma.mk aY) (hsu s' fun i => ?_)
   140	    have hmem := (Over.sigmaExtension_map_mk_eq_iff (𝓤.f i) (ha i) s' ((x i).2)).mp
   141	      (ht' i)
   142	    rwa [pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply] at hmem
   143	
   144	/-- **The Σ-extension of the degree-zero Picard functor, bundled as a sheaf on the
   145	big Zariski site** — the object mathlib's 01JJ local-representability engine
   146	consumes. -/
   147	noncomputable def pic0SigmaSheaf : Sheaf Scheme.zariskiTopology.{u} (Type u) :=
   148	  ⟨pic0SigmaFunctor C,
   149	    (isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_of_type _ _).mpr (pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheaf C)⟩
   150	
   151	/-! ## The DAT-glue seam -/
   152	
   153	/-- **The DAT-glue statement (worksheet §4, DAT-glue row)**: a chart family of
   154	relatively representable open immersions into the Σ-extension sheaf (DAT-C's
   155	certificates) that is jointly Zariski-locally surjective (DAT-B's coverage) induces —
   156	through mathlib's 01JJ engine and the stage-2 Σ-descent — a representation of the
   157	type-valued degree-zero Picard functor by the glued scheme placed over the
   158	Σ-component of the universal element.  The represented object's `.left` is
   159	`(Scheme.LocalRepresentability.glueData hf).glued` and its `.hom` is the universal
   160	element's Σ-component, both definitionally. -/
   161	noncomputable def pic0RepresentableByOfCharts
   162	    {ι : Type u} {X : ι → Scheme.{u}}
   163	    (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)
   164	    (hf : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (f i))
   165	    [Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology (Sigma.desc f)] :
   166	    (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy
   167	      (Over.mk ((Scheme.LocalRepresentability.representableBy hf).homEquiv
   168	        (𝟙 (Scheme.LocalRepresentability.glueData hf).glued)).1) :=
   169	  (Scheme.LocalRepresentability.representableBy hf).overSlice
